The cassette has a dark gray or black plastic body with a cream-colored paper label on the top face. Visible features include two circular windows revealing the internal tape spools (one with reddish tape), a central rectangular window showing the tape path, and small mechanical details like write-protect tabs and screw holes. There is faint, illegible text on the label and a digital-style date stamp '2179 AU' in the bottom left corner.
